aiOverview.content: The New Moon in April 2026 occurs on Friday, April 17, 2026, at 7:52 a.m. EDT (11:52 UTC). This lunar phase takes place in the sign of Aries, marking a moment for new beginnings, high energy, and significant personal, energetic, or life-trajectory changes.Key Details for April 17, 2026 New Moon:Sign: The New Moon is in Aries.Time: 7:51-7:52 a.m. EDT (12:52 Europe/London).Astrological Significance: A rare, powerful "stellium" of planets—including the Moon, Sun, Mercury, Mars, Saturn, and Neptune—are in Aries, suggesting an intense period for starting new projects, acting with impulsivity, and setting goals.Impacted Signs: While everyone will experience this energy, it is most intense for cardinal signs: Aries, Cancer, Libra, and Capricorn.Other April 2026 Moon Phases:Full Moon: April 2, 2026Third Quarter: April 10, 2026First Quarter: April 24, 2026The new moon is part of a high-energy, "fire" week that also brings a chance for auroras due to a G2 geomagnetic storm watch in effect.
